name: SK_Fish_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

rig.rest_pose: standing pose as modelled (not a T pose)
rig.animation: none: skeleton and skin weights only; no clips, no Physics Asset, no control rig
rig.skeleton: bespoke (CONVENTIONS.md section 11: any skeleton with a single root bone named root)

pivot: feet: armature origin on the ground between the feet, front on -Y
dresses: trout-built fish, 52 cm with the tail: dark blue-grey back, silver flanks with a rosy band and black spots, pale belly, rayed fins
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: Body is one swept solid with gill and mouth lines pressed in: no opening mouth, gill covers, nostrils or lateral-line scales, and the scale pattern is a Voronoi grid in the normal map. Fins are 1.2 mm opaque shells with rays painted on; real fins are translucent. A generic trout: the original frame is a pale blue fish seen from above through water. Seven-bone spine chain with automatic weights, checked in one bend (render_pose.png); no swim or flop clips, which is what both families actually show. The flopping fish is this mesh on its side.
